memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The young woman ran and told her mother's household about these things. Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring. As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister's arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring. 'Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,' he said. 'Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.' So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet." - Gen 24:28-32 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Step by step, the way keeps opening. Rebekah runs home, her brother Laban hurries out, and soon the servant is welcomed into the house, his camels fed and his feet washed. What began as a prayer at a well is now an open door into the family.

Laban's motives may have been mixed — he certainly noticed the gold jewelry — yet God was still moving the whole situation forward. This is a comforting truth: God can accomplish His purposes even through imperfect people. He is not limited by the mixed hearts of those around us.

When God is leading, doors tend to open in the right order and at the right time. The servant did not have to force his way in; hospitality was extended to him. This does not mean every open door is God's will — we still need wisdom (Acts 16:6-10). But when we have prayed and stepped out in obedience, we can trust God to arrange the details we cannot control.

Are you praying about a way forward? Take the next faithful step and watch how God opens what needs to open. Rest in the truth that He goes before you, preparing the path.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I trusting God to open the right doors in His time?
2. Where do I need to stop forcing and start trusting?
3. Can I thank God that He works even through imperfect people?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You go before me and open doors in Your perfect timing. Help me to take the next faithful step and trust You with the rest. Amen.
